botella.lede: Tall, black, faceted, with an electric blue label. It doesn't ask for attention. It was designed to earn it.
botella.story_h: Three friends, one festival, and no good tequila to drink.
botella.story_p: Once upon a time there were three friends, who were lovers of electronic music and were always looking for new experiences to enjoy to the fullest. One weekend, they decided to attend a famous electronic music festival in Croatia, known for its vibrant and energetic atmosphere.
story: During the festival, the friends encountered a small inconvenience: there was no good tequila to drink. As true lovers of this spirit, they were disappointed and decided it was time to take matters into their own hands.

It was then that, in the middle of a drunken state and with the music ringing in their ears, they came up with a bold idea: create their own tequila. But not just any tequila, but one that met the highest quality standards and was exclusive for those who enjoyed the moment and enjoyed the good life.

Determined to carry out their plan, the friends sought the guidance of someone who knew the world of tequila in depth. It was then that they met Cap, a Mexican outlaw who had an excessive passion for tequila and partying with beautiful girls.

Cap taught them everything he knew about the tequila making process, from the planting of the agave to the final distillation. The friends immersed themselves in the world of tequila, learning about the different varieties, flavors and aromas that characterized it.

With the knowledge gained, this 3 amigos began their journey to create their own brand of tequila. They partnered with local farmers in Mexico to source the purest, highest quality agave. They took care of every detail of the distillation process, making sure every drop of tequila was perfect.

After years of hard work, they finally launched their tequila brand: "Velvique". A smooth and silky tequila, made exclusively with pure and 100% Mexican agave. It was a spirit that could be enjoyed by both young people and adults with a discerning palate and a sense of good taste.

The "Velvique" brand quickly gained popularity among tequila lovers. Their unique flavor and exceptional quality made them stand out in the industry. Soon, his tequila became the preferred drink at parties and exclusive events, where the good life and enjoying the moment were paramount.

The friends achieved their goal of creating an exceptional tequila and shared their success with cap, who became their official ambassador. Together, they enjoyed life, music and beautiful girls, always toasting with Velvique, the silky elixir of pure agave, made with passion and dedication in Mexico.
botella.story_end: And so, the story of this three amigos and Cap teaches us that sometimes, the best ideas arise at the most unexpected moments. With determination and passion, they managed to create something velvet and unique, leaving a mark on the tequila industry and in the hearts of those who enjoy the good life.
botella.liquid_p: Añejo cristalino tequila of pure, 100% Mexican agave from local farmers in Mexico. Rested in oak barrels, then charcoal-filtered to strip the color, not the character: a cristalino with depth, smooth and silky.
process: Pure Mexican agave from local farmers, slow-cooked.
Black faceted glass, a label with its own light.
notes: Smooth and silky, full-bodied. Quiet oak.
certs: Made to kosher standards: trust, and more tables where it can be poured.
Careful production and a cleaner premium proposition.
Meets Mexico's official tequila standard. Verified legitimacy.
botella.led_p: The label lights the monogram and the name. It breathes slowly, like a candle. It doesn’t flicker, doesn’t change color, isn’t for the dance floor: it’s for the table.
serve: Lightly chilled. It brings out the silkiness and the long finish.
Crisp, balanced serves where Velvique stays present, not buried.
Turn off the table light. Let the bottle do the rest.
botella.unbox_p: Rigid black box, magnetic close, the bottle lying on velvet. Lift it and it lights up. Underneath, the card with your bottle’s code.

verificar.lede: Every Velvique bottle leaves with a unique serial number, printed on the card that sits under the bottle. That number goes into a public record nobody can erase or alter, not even us. Type it here and in seconds you'll know whether what you're holding is Velvique.
verificar.input_hint: You'll find it on the card under the bottle when you open the box.
how: Every bottle gets its own serial number. No two are alike.
That number is recorded next to the real order the bottle came from.
You check it here. No account, no sign-up, no asking anyone's permission.
verificar.why_p: Premium spirits get counterfeited: refilled bottles, copied labels, reused boxes. Usually the only guarantee is the word of whoever sells it to you. With Velvique the proof is public and permanent: anyone can check it, today or ten years from now, at a party or at a bar.
see: If the number exists in Velvique's record.
The order the bottle belongs to.
If the buyer has already registered it in their name.
faq: No. Verifying is open to anyone: all you need is the number on the card.
Technically it's a blockchain record: a public database no single party controls and that can't be edited after the fact. That's why the proof doesn't depend on us.
What does registering it in my name mean?
If you placed the order, once it arrives you can register the bottle in your name. It leaves a record that it's yours.
What if it doesn't show up?
Don't open it. Tell the place you bought it from and message us on our socials with a photo of the card.
verificar.ok_p: This number is in Velvique's record and came from a real order. What you're holding is Velvique.
verificar.no_p: This number isn't in the record. Check you typed it exactly as on the card. If it still doesn't show up, don't open it and message us on our socials with a photo of the card.
verificar.claim_p: Only the person who placed the order can register it, and only after receiving it.
verificar.claimed_ok: Done. It's registered in your name.
verificar.not_deployed: The bottle registry opens with the first production run. Keep your bottle's card: you'll check it here.

mayoreo.lede: Bars, clubs, hotels and distributors. Your bar doesn't compete for shelf space: it competes on curation. Velvique becomes the venue's signature, not another bottle on the back bar.
mayoreo.story_p: Your crowd, 21 to 50, doesn't just drink: it buys experience, status and story. Velvique sits next to the champagne, not the shots, and a lit bottle on the table is the best advertising a venue has.
mayoreo.offer_h: We don't sell you a product. We build a partnership.
offer: Signature cocktails shaped to your bar's style, ready to execute without feeling forced.
Presentation materials and a service script so your team sells Velvique naturally.
Together we define where, when and how the bottle is pushed: a decision, not inventory.
Activation ideas for reels and photo moments, so the bottle travels beyond the bar.
